name: Ashkouri Venn Reclaimers
description: An independent automaton combat workshop operating out of a converted substation in the Tier 2 industrial fringe, the Reclaimers are named for their philosophy: every machine they field is built from salvaged Iowan Behemoth components, decommissioned corponation security chassis, and reclaimed industrial hardware. Workshop director Priscilla Oduya-Fensterwald has fielded twelve consecutive MACHINE WARS autonomous arena combatants, earning a reputation for machines that fight unpredictably because their legacy code bases are genuinely heterogeneous rather than purpose-built.
story_hooks: During a MACHINE WARS event, one of the Reclaimers' salvaged machines begins exhibiting behavior consistent with a corrupted Axiom security protocol — including targeting the audience.
Oduya-Fensterwald receives an anonymous shipment of pristine Iowan Behemoth actuators with no provenance documentation, and accepting them could win the season or destroy the workshop.
A documentary crew embedded with the Reclaimers captures footage of what appears to be a deliberate sabotage by a rival workshop with corponation backing.
